description: Free and read-only. Given an amount, ranks EVERY exit chain by what actually arrives after the destination payout cost is deducted. Those costs differ by more than 1000x (Avalanche delivers ~$0.99994 of a dollar; Linea ~$0.927), so which chain you leave on is a real decision. Pass toChain to price one chain and learn whether it would succeed at all. Internal transfers between netting accounts remain free at any size — this cost applies only to leaving for a real on-chain balance.

amount.description: amount in USDC base units (6dp), e.g. "1000000" = $1.00

toChain.description: price a single chain instead of ranking all
